Introduction

WaterFire is a four-member group formed through the MNET program Build Up: Vocal Boy Group. They officially debuted on May 30, 2024.

Team WaterFire placed third in the finale, after which Lynna Entertainment announced that the four members would continue together as a project group. The group consists of UP10TION's Sunyoul, Wumuti, Kang Ha Yoon, and Choi Su Hwan. They were expected to debut on May 30, 2024.

On April 11, 2024, WaterFire announced their fandom name, For : rest (숲 : 휴식을 위한), meaning "We hope our songs bring you relaxation."

On April 26, 2024, the group revealed that the members' individual companies had established a joint venture called WaterFire Company. Each member will continue solo activities under their respective agencies but will promote as a group under the newly established WaterFire Company.
